shots.title: Cube lands
shots.description: A deeper orange cube drops in, bounces once and settles in the centre.

shots.title: Logo lockup
shots.description: The wordmark snaps in letter by letter as the cube shrinks into the logo.

shots.title: Word slams
shots.description: Four feature words slam in on the beat, and ICONS stays lit.

shots.title: All-in-one dashboard
shots.description: The camera whips to the first panel, then carries on across the others.

shots.title: Icons and flows
shots.description: Pixel agents pop in one at a time, and the first turns orange.

shots.title: Call to action
shots.description: The background floods orange, and the CTA types on.
